recognize_zh: ERG 在沿血管腔排列的內襯細胞核呈強陽性，而周圍淋巴球與間質細胞核為陰性（藍色）；清楚標示病灶的血管腔是由內皮系細胞構成。
features: Strong nuclear ERG staining in cells lining vascular channels
Positive nuclei aligned in a single layer along channel walls and in small capillaries
Lining cell nuclei ovoid, some plump
Intervening lymphoid and stromal cells ERG-negative
Red cells and proteinaceous material in lumens
describe_en: ERG immunostain shows strong nuclear staining in the cells lining the vascular channels and small capillaries of the splenic lesion, with negative intervening lymphoid and stromal cells. The lining cells form a single layer without solid clusters. The findings confirm endothelial differentiation of the lining cells, supporting a vascular lesion such as littoral cell angioma when interpreted with histiocytic marker coexpression.

ddx.vs: Both are ERG-positive; hemangioma lacks CD68/CD163/CD21 and is CD34-positive.
Angiosarcoma is also ERG-positive but shows multilayering, atypia, solid areas and high proliferation.
Carcinoma cells are cytokeratin-positive and ERG-negative (except prostate), forming cohesive nests rather than a single lining layer.
